psychological_meaning: Aquamarine evokes feelings of calmness, tranquility, and clarity, reminiscent of the sea. It is often associated with peace, serenity, and sophistication. This color promotes relaxation, creativity, and inspiration, fostering a sense of emotional balance and well-being. Its gentle and soothing nature makes it an ideal choice for creating a harmonious and inviting atmosphere.
